thread:
Ellen: Heads-up - bringing up panthera-6b (Llama->Mistral->Gemma export) quant=int4. Short chats fine, but after ~170 tokens output collapses to lots of <unk> and token 0. Anyone seen packer/remap + rotary interaction?

Vik: Which converter and flags? densify/prune? Did you produce a remap.json?

Ellen: Used exportx v1.2 with --densify --prune-low (defaults). No remap emitted by default. Normalised with NFKC. Repro log snippet:
```
[INF] step=168 token=287 logp=-3.0
[INF] step=169 token=0 logp=-14.0
[WARN] sudden token-0 spike at step 169
```

Samir: token 0 spike usually means either pad/EOS aliasing or quant packing collision when sparse ids are naively compacted. Did the source vocab have invisible or emoji tokens in head slots?

Ellen: Yep, head looked like ['<pad>','<unk>','\u200B','the',':sparkle:','to','a','\u00A0'] so invisible/nbsp present. After densify some disappeared and ids shifted.

Vik: Two likely culprits we saw before: 1) densifier collapsed sparse->dense ids but packer assumed contiguous range so new ids alias to 0 in packed bytes; 2) rotary precompute fast-path used token_id as an index in a memo table in one legacy path. If ids change mid-sequence, phase memo returns wrong sin/cos and you get immediate collapse.

Samir: Can you re-run with --emit-remap and --preserve-reserved? Also disable densify to see baseline. Compare ppl.

Ellen: Re-ran: densify+no-remap PPL ~29, emit-remap+preserve PPL ~12.8 (baseline ~12.5). Problem disappeared.

Vik: Action items: 1) default converters should emit remap.json and not densify unless --force-densify. 2) add a converter lint: fail if invisible/control/emoji tokens in top-K would be moved into pad/unk/eos slots. 3) runtime should validate remap.json on model load and refuse to pack ids into bytes if remap implies sparse mapping that would alias. 4) change rotary precompute fast-path to use position-based table (or require explicit remap) to avoid token-id heuristics.

Samir: Also add a small sliding-window continuity eval up to 512 tokens (3 seeds) comparing mean logp delta vs baseline, fail on >0.4. And a unit test that fails if token 0 frequency >3% on long prompts.

Ellen: I'll open PR with converter defaults, lint, remap emission, and add the two tests + a short note in onboarding/compat.md about packer vs remap and rotary caveats.

bot-qa: queued: build 2115 for exportx on branch onboard/panthera-remap :white_check_mark:

Vik: Nice. One doc caveat: tweaking rotary-scale can sometimes mask early symptoms but isn't a fix; call that out.

Ellen: Good call, will include. Thanks all :thumbsup:
summary: panthera-6b onboarding: densify w/o remap caused quant-pack aliasing and token-id-based rotary memoization to fail; fixed by emitting remap, preserving reserved tokens, and adding lints/tests
